chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ismāʿīl ibn Saʿd al-Ashʿarī, who said:
I asked al-Riḍā عليه السلام about a man who touches the private part of his slave-girl until fluid is discharged, without intercourse, playing with her with his hand until she discharges.
He said: "If she discharges out of desire, then ghusl is obligatory upon her."
ai.seo_question: Does ghusl become obligatory if a woman discharges from desire without intercourse?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning janabah and the obligation of ghusl in a case where discharge occurs without intercourse. Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام states that if the woman discharges from shahwah, then ghusl becomes obligatory upon her.
